records.question: 订单明细一共有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM order_items;

records.question: 数据库里一共有多少个客户?
records.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers) AS cust_rows, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders) AS cust_with_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE c.region IS NULL) AS region_null;

records.question: 2014 年一共下了多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2014';

records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country AS country, ROUND(SUM(i.sales),2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items AS i
INNER JOIN orders AS o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
INNER JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5;

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.sql: SELECT p.category AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit),2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific' AND oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

records.question: Consumer 类型的客户有多少个?
records.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY segment;

records.question: 平均折扣最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?

records.question: 利润为负的亏损明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(profit) AS non_null_profit, SUM(CASE WHEN profit < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN profit < 0 THEN profit ELSE 0 END) AS loss_amount FROM order_items

records.question: 运费最高的 5 行明细,列出行号和运费。
records.sql: SELECT row_id, shipping_cost FROM order_items ORDER BY shipping_cost DESC, row_id LIMIT 5;

records.question: 美国的客户有多少个?

records.question: 2013 年 12 月的总销售额是多少?

records.question: 下单次数最多的 3 个客户,列出客户编号和订单数。

records.question: Technology 大类平均每行明细的销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_cnt, AVG(sales) AS avg_sales, SUM(sales) AS total_sales, COUNT(sales) AS non_null_sales FROM order_items JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id WHERE products.category = 'Technology'

records.question: 折扣不低于 0.3 的明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(discount) AS min_d, MAX(discount) AS max_d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items) AS total_rows FROM order_items WHERE discount >= 0.3;

records.question: 每种配送方式各有多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT ship_mode, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders GROUP BY ship_mode ORDER BY order_cnt DESC;

records.question: 数量小于等于 0 的异常明细有哪些行号?
records.sql: SELECT row_id, order_id, product_id, sales, quantity, discount, profit, shipping_cost FROM order_items WHERE quantity <= 0 ORDER BY row_id

records.question: 各市场的总利润分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT g.market, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
GROUP BY g.market
ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

records.question: 2013 和 2014 两年各自的总销售额是多少?

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, ROUND(SUM(i.sales),2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(i.profit),2) AS total_profit, ROUND(SUM(i.profit)/SUM(i.sales),4) AS profit_margin FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL AND i.profit IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY profit_margin DESC

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(i.sales,0)),2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(i.sales,0))*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS avg_per_order
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id
WHERE c.segment='Corporate' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales
FROM (
  SELECT sales,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM order_items
  WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)

records.question: 每种订单优先级各有多少张订单?

records.question: region 为空的客户有哪些客户编号?
records.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.country, c.region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_cnt FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.region IS NULL OR TRIM(c.region) = '' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.country, c.region ORDER BY c.customer_id;

records.question: 剔除数量为 0 或负数、销售额为空的异常明细后,总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN quantity <= 0 OR sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN quantity > 0 AND sales IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clean_rows,
       ROUND(SUM(sales), 2) AS total_sales_all,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN quantity > 0 AND sales IS NOT NULL THEN sales END), 2) AS clean_sales
FROM order_items;

records.question: 每种客户类型(segment)各有多少个客户?

records.question: 2012 年每个月各有多少张订单?

records.question: 销售额最高的 5 行明细,列出行号和销售额。

records.question: 客户数量最多的 5 个国家是哪些?

records.question: 三个商品大类各有多少张订单(按订单号去重)?

records.question: 2014 年按月的利润趋势是怎样的?
records.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt, ROUND(SUM(i.sales),2) AS sales, ROUND(SUM(i.profit),2) AS profit, ROUND(SUM(i.profit)/NULLIF(SUM(i.sales),0)*100,2) AS margin_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym;

records.question: 按配送方式统计总销售额。
records.sql:
SELECT o.ship_mode, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.ship_mode
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

records.question: 没有任何商品明细的订单有几张?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_item_orders FROM orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id);

records.question: 折扣正好为 0 的明细有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_discount_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items) AS total_rows FROM order_items WHERE discount = 0;

records.question: 库里最早和最晚的订单日期分别是哪天?
records.sql: SELECT MIN(order_date) AS min_date, MAX(order_date) AS max_date, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders;

records.question: 累计消费总额最高的 3 个客户,列出客户编号和消费总额。
records.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.segment, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_cnt
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.segment
ORDER BY SUM(oi.sales) DESC
LIMIT 3;

records.question: 各国家的总利润分别是多少?
records.sql: SELECT c.country AS country, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit),2) AS total_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的市场是哪个?
records.sql:
SELECT g.market, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, SUM(oi.profit)*1.0/SUM(oi.sales) AS margin, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY g.market
ORDER BY margin DESC;

records.question: Technology 大类 2014 年的总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS rows_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.category = 'Technology'
AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(AVG(oi.profit),2) AS avg_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit),2) AS total_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.profit IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category HAVING AVG(oi.profit) < 0 ORDER BY avg_profit

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY total_profit ASC;
